mapper.select: select INDENTIFY_MARK as indentifyMark, CASE WHEN MAX(CNY_AMT) < 6000000 THEN '02' ELSE '03' END holderType, 'E' status, NOW() updateTime, NOW() createTime from chb_investhold_info_sub where HOLD_DATE=STR_TO_DATE(#{excuteDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND CNY_AMT>1000000 GROUP BY INDENTIFY_MARK

SELECT sub.INDENTIFY_MARK AS indentifyMark, sub.ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK AS orgIndentifyMark, sub.REGIST_BANK_CODE AS bankCode, sub.IS_BELONG_BANK AS isBelongBank, sub.THE_BANK_NAME AS theBankName, sub.THE_BANK_CODE AS theBankCode, sub.HOLDER_MARK AS holderMark, sub.HOLDER_REGION AS holderRegion, tmp.HOLDER_TYPE AS holderType, sub.TYPE AS type, sub.PERSONAL_IDENTIFY_TYPE AS personalIdentifyType, sub.INSTITUTION_IDENTIFY_TYPE AS institutionIdentifyType, sub.OTHER_IDENTIFY_NAME AS otherIdentifyName, sub.IDENTIFY_NUMBER AS identifyNumber, sub.SPV_CAP_ACC_BANK AS spvCapAccBank, sub.OTHER_CAP_ACC_BANK AS otherCapAccBank, sub.SPV_REGIST_CODE AS spvRegistCode, sub.HOLDER_DATE AS holderDate, sub.HOLDER_NAME AS holderName, sub.HOLDER_SEX AS holderSex, sub.HOLDER_RISK_PREFER AS holderRiskPrefer, sub.HOLDER_CELLPHONE AS holderCellphone, sub.HOLDER_TELEPHONE AS holderTelephone, sub.HOLDER_EMAIL AS holderEmail, sub.REMARK AS remark, sub.STATUS AS status, sub.DEPT_CODE AS deptCode, sub.UPDATE_USER AS updateUser, sub.UPDATE_TIME AS updateTime, sub.CREATE_USER AS createUser, sub.ORG_CODE AS orgCode, sub.SUBMIT_STATUS AS submitStatus from (select t.* from ( select qu.*, rank() over (partition by INDENTIFY_MARK order by SUBMIT_STATUS ) rk from CHB_EQU_SUB qu ) t where rk=1 ) sub inner join chb_equ_type_tmp tmp on sub.INDENTIFY_MARK=tmp.INDENTIFY_MARK and sub.HOLDER_TYPE != tmp.HOLDER_TYPE where sub.STATUS in ('01','02')
